name: Ampère Scholarships of Excellence (Bourse d'excellence Ampère) — ENS de Lyon
requiredDocuments: Certificate of diplomas and degrees already obtained (e.g. Bachelor degree) — accepted only in French or English; if in another language, provide an officially certified French/English translation
University academic transcript of records — accepted only in French or English; if in another language, provide an officially certified French/English translation
Proof of enrollment for the current year (in French or English)

Additional documents depending on the chosen program (may include research project, language certificates, letters of recommendation, or any document useful to the academic advisors; if a document is unavailable, a PDF explanation is expected)

timeline.notes: Dates are the official 2026-2027 cycle from the ENS de Lyon calendar (opened 14 Nov 2025, closed 23 Jan 2026). As of the 2026-06 anchor the 2026-2027 call is closed and the page states the 2027-2028 calendar 'will be updated in November 2026'. The earlier 2025-2026 article showed a 31 Jan 2025 deadline; the deadline has moved slightly earlier (late January).

benefits: Monthly living allowance of 1,000 EUR per month for 12 months (one academic year)
Paid in three installments: end of October (4 months), end of February (4 months), end of May (4 months)
Renewable under conditions for a second year of the same Master's program
Covers enrollment in any eligible ENS de Lyon Master's program in the Exact Sciences, the Arts, or the Human & Social Sciences (M1 or M2)
mustKnow: LIVING-STIPEND ONLY, NOT FULLY FUNDED: the award is 1,000 EUR/month for 12 months and nothing else. No tuition waiver, airfare, health insurance, or settlement allowance is listed on any official ENS de Lyon page or in the Ampère rules PDF. (ENS de Lyon master's programs are billed at France's low national public-university registration rate, which the student still pays.)

BANGLADESH-ELIGIBLE: applicants apply as a 'non-European student with a higher-education degree obtained in a foreign country' via a dedicated online form. Non-European is defined as not holding EEA (EU 27 + Norway/Iceland/Liechtenstein), Swiss, Monaco or Andorra nationality, plus a foreign higher-education degree. There is NO bilateral country list and no country exclusion — a Bangladeshi national qualifies. (The US/Canada/India 'specific partnerships' mentioned on the page are additional embassy scholarships, not eligibility restrictions.)

STRICT MOBILITY/INTERNSHIP RULES (Ampère rules PDF): a beneficiary must NOT carry out a study or research period abroad, and any compulsory internship must be in a laboratory affiliated to ENS de Lyon. First-year beneficiaries get NO exemption from the lab-affiliation rule; internships in the student's own country of origin are never authorized.

REPAYMENT/CLAWBACK RISK: ENS de Lyon can stop payment and demand reimbursement of sums already paid if obligations are breached (poor attendance, missing exams without justification, exam failure without sitting the resit, study/research abroad, etc.).

OBLIGATIONS to keep the scholarship: full registration in an ENS de Lyon master's and proof of registration before 20 September; sign an attendance sheet on the 1st Tuesday of October, December, February and May; attend all classes/practicals/seminars; sit all exams (including resits).

SINGLE FORM = ADMISSION + SCHOLARSHIP: the one online application is BOTH a master's admission and a scholarship application, decided by the ENS de Lyon admission committee. Using the wrong form (European vs non-European vs French-degree) means the application is not considered.

ELIGIBILITY/AGE TABLE NOT VERIFIABLE: ENS de Lyon references a separate downloadable 'table of eligibility criteria for Merit Scholarships' on the application page, but neither that table's age limit nor any age cut-off appears in the public HTML or the retrieved rules PDF. Confirm the current age/eligibility table directly with the International Student Office before applying.

DEGREE REQUIREMENTS: for M1 you must hold an L3 / Bachelor (180 ECTS) or foreign equivalent; for M2 an M1 (240 ECTS) or foreign equivalent. The required diploma, if not yet available, must be submitted before the start of the academic year (compulsory).
SEPARATE 'GRADUATE +' SCHOLARSHIP exists for specific Graduate initiatives (CORE, DynLifeSys, MathInfi, PACE) at 1,000 EUR/month for 10 months — a different award from Ampère.
Applications are online only; late, email, or incomplete applications are not considered — it is the applicant's responsibility to verify every requested document is uploaded.

universities: École Normale Supérieure de Lyon (ENS de Lyon)

duration: 12 months (one academic year), renewable under conditions for a second master's year
eligibleNationalities: Open to international students with no country exclusion. Applicants apply either as European (EEA/EU/Norway/Iceland/Liechtenstein) or as non-European (any nationality outside the EEA, Switzerland, Monaco, Andorra) holding a higher-education degree obtained abroad. Bangladeshi nationals apply via the non-European track.
languageRequirements: Prerequisites in English and/or French depending on the discipline and level; only tests listed in the ENS de Lyon reference grids are accepted, and a certificate of English and/or French level may be required. Exemptions apply if you studied in a French- or English-speaking country or completed your studies entirely in French or English (verify per-program requirements).
renewalConditions: Awarded for an initial 12 months; renewable under conditions for a second master's year (must maintain full registration, attendance, sit all exams, and comply with the Ampère rules and ENS de Lyon internal regulations).
bondObligation: No return-home bond, but funding is conditional: study/research abroad is prohibited during the award, compulsory internships must be in an ENS de Lyon-affiliated lab (never in the student's country of origin), and breaches trigger stopping the scholarship and repayment of sums already received.
